title: ze_bisounours_party
description:
ze_bisounours_party is the first Zombie Escape map I ever created. It originally released to Counter-Strike: Source and has been ported and upgraded to Counter-Strike: Global Offensive by the Rule of P team!
I decided to start my CS2 porting journey with this map.
I almost didn't edit anything, visual updates might come later !

Have fun

Updated 16/08/2026
